title: Passport on File now follows the real files
text: On a contact's page (Identity & Tax) and in the Contacts list, "Passport on File" now says Yes whenever the person's passport is really there: in their Storage folder, or among their older documents. Before, it only looked at a saved Yes/No that most Storage uploads never set, so people with a passport on file showed No.
points: Open a contact whose passport is in their Storage folder: it now says Yes.
Nothing is changed on the contact; it only shows the real answer.
